documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Notice Of Extra-Ordinary General Meeting Scheduled To Be Held On October 27, 2026

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported revenue and profit growth for FY19 and Q1FY20, driven by international expansion and volume growth, despite domestic weakness caused by severe weather conditions in Q4. Management highlighted stable raw material costs covered through Q2 with plans for price hikes in the second half due to rising milk prices. The company continues to focus on debt rationalization, brand building, and capital expenditure of Rs. 30-35 crore for the year. Furthermore, management remains optimistic about delivering double-digit growth with higher international contributions leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double digit growth with a higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management expects another good performance in FY20 by leveraging the Vadilal brand.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Growth is expected to be driven by a continued focus on domestic business and lower input costs.
guidance.quote: Continued focus on developing domestic business and lower input costs expected to drive growth

guidance.claim: The company maintains its positive business outlook driven by a better consumption environment, demand shift to the organized sector, and continued international traction.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is now reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Vadilal's Q3 FY19 revenues grew 27% y-o-y driven by domestic business growth of 12%.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q3 FY19 VIL revenues grew by 27% y-o-y driven by 12% y-o-y growth in the domestic business

demand_outlook.claim: International business revenues grew by 71% y-o-y.
demand_outlook.quote: International business revenues grew by 71% yoy

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: International business has witnessed robust demand as distribution was expanded and products focused on the Indian diaspora were sold.
demand_outlook.quote: International business has witnessed robust demand as VIL expanded distribution and is selling products focused on Indian diaspora in the US and other geographies

capex_expansion.claim: The company has committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. for widespread access to the Indian diaspora.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capital expenditure for FY19 is around Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated for capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and larger international contributions.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, driven partly by U.S. operations having over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: Other operating expenses were kept under tight control and remained almost unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: However, we have kept a tight control on other operating expenses that remained almost unchanged.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Visibility of stable costs is covered till Q2 based on raw material purchases and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Prices will be increased in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels now.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 FY19 from 40% in Q3 FY18.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company has visibility on input costs after closing key supply arrangements for the summer season.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax increased to Rs. 40 crore in 9M FY19 from Rs. 15 crore in 9M FY18.
margins_costs.quote: Flow down of these initiatives have resulted in profit after tax expanding from Rs. 15 crore to Rs. 40 crore in the first nine months of FY19.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal is present in 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states in India.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we are present in 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states across the country.

orders_capacity.claim: The Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh plant has an ice cream production capacity of 150,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005

orders_capacity.claim: The Pundhra, Gujarat plant has an ice cream production capacity of 230,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Operational surplus will be leveraged to restructure debt and improve working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions extending the winter till the end of March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic growth experienced temporary impact from recent operating environment changes and consumption spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore in capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to look at increasing prices in the second half of the year as milk prices are higher.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management sees another good year in FY20 as it leverages its brand for growth.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

management_commitments.claim: The company estimated capex for FY19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to expanding its retail network judiciously.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
